sources.title: Goodbye bloop
sources.locator: Louis Knight-Webb, April 10, 2026; opening and final paragraphs
sources.finding: bloop announced its closure and an open-source, community-maintained continuation. Subscriptions were terminated and recent invoices refunded. Remote services had a 30-day transition window, covering kanban issues, comments, projects and organisations. Local workspaces would continue. No exact service-end date is stated.

sources.title: Release v0.1.44
sources.locator: Release date and What's Changed, especially PR 3387
sources.finding: Latest release listed at retrieval is v0.1.44, published April 24, 2026. It includes export-only project routes, Claude Code 2.1.119 and Codex 0.124.0 updates. Release assets include desktop packages; this is release evidence, not a successful installation.

sources.title: What would a community edition of Vibe Kanban look like?
sources.locator: Louis/stunningpixels opening June 2 and reply June 7
sources.finding: Louis asks for community direction and maintainers. His June 7 reply calls the earlier orchestrator experiment unreleased. This is a discussion, not a committed feature delivery schedule.

sources.title: packages/web-core/src/pages/kanban/ProjectKanban.tsx
sources.locator: ProjectKanban, final return after authentication/project checks
sources.finding: LocalProjectKanban and RemoteProjectKanbanShell both call this shared page. It returns ProjectSunsetPage instead of the board, with no alternate branch for a self-hosted API. This links the released project route to the retired UI.

sources.title: packages/web-core/src/pages/kanban/ProjectSunsetPage.tsx
sources.locator: ProjectSunsetPage, heading and export button
sources.finding: The accessible replacement page labels projects retired/export-only and links to data export. The restriction applies to project-scoped kanban, issue and workspace flows here, not the separate local Workspaces UI.

sources.title: packages/web-core/src/pages/export/ExportPage.tsx
sources.locator: ExportPageContainer, exportFn and sign-in gate
sources.finding: Export UI requires sign-in, lists organisations/projects and POSTs /v1/export. It offers CSV and optional attachments; source existence does not establish current hosted download access.

sources.title: crates/remote/src/routes/export.rs
sources.locator: export_data; issues.csv, projects.csv, users.csv and optional attachments
sources.finding: Authenticated export writes a ZIP containing issues, projects and users CSVs plus optional attachment manifest/files. Issue columns include status, priority, assignees and parent issue. This is not a demonstrated full-history import/restore path.

sources.title: crates/tauri-app/tauri.conf.json
sources.locator: productName, version, build and bundle
sources.finding: Release desktop client uses Tauri configuration version 0.1.44 and all bundle targets. The desktop UI is a webview, not evidence of platform-native widgets.

sources.title: crates/tauri-app/src/main.rs
sources.locator: WebviewUrl::External and create_main_window/WebviewWindowBuilder
sources.finding: Desktop startup launches the web UI in a Tauri webview, including a local-server URL. This connects the shipped Tauri configuration to the desktop window.

sources.title: crates/executors/src/executors/mod.rs
sources.locator: CodingAgent enum; capabilities and MCP configuration
sources.finding: Released adapters enumerate Claude Code, Amp, Gemini, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor Agent, Qwen Code, Copilot and Droid. Agent settings/MCP support vary by adapter.

sources.title: crates/executors/src/executors/codex.rs
sources.locator: spawn_inner and launch_codex_agent, approximately lines 564-630
sources.finding: Codex executor starts an app-server client, checks authentication and starts/forks a thread for session work. It integrates structured session operations rather than only opening a terminal.

sources.title: crates/mcp/src/task_server/tools/sessions.rs
sources.locator: create_session, list_sessions, run_session_prompt, get_execution, approximately lines 145-350
sources.finding: MCP tools call local /api/sessions and execution-process endpoints to create/list sessions, submit follow-up turns and inspect executions. They check workspace scope. No calls were executed in this research.

sources.finding: start_workspace sends a prompt and repository configuration to /api/workspaces/start. Linking an issue is optional and uses remote issue endpoints when requested. This establishes a local programmatic start path without a hosted issue.

sources.title: Changes Panel
sources.locator: Diff Viewer; Giving Feedback with Comments; Agent Response to Comments; GitHub Integration
sources.finding: Local diff comments are sent with a subsequent message to the agent. The panel also documents displaying submitted GitHub PR review comments, excluding pending reviews. This is documented review behavior, not an observed runtime result or proof of two-way synchronization.

sources.title: crates/server/src/routes/workspaces/git.rs
sources.locator: merge_workspace, call to git().merge_changes with the workspace branch and target branch
sources.finding: The released workspace merge route passes the repository path, workspace worktree, workspace branch and target branch to merge_changes to merge the workspace branch into its target branch; it refuses remote target branches and workspaces with an open PR, then archives unpinned workspaces. The merge_changes implementation was not read and the route was not run. The Git operations page separately describes a Merge action pulling the target into the working branch.

sources.title: Vibe Kanban docs/workspaces/managing-workspaces.mdx
sources.locator: Archive/delete; Disk space; Manual worktree deletion; Orphan cleanup
sources.finding: Local archive keeps history/sessions/notes/worktree; deletion removes workspace data/worktree but leaves branch and commits. Missing manually deleted worktree rebuilds from last commit and loses uncommitted changes. Startup cleans orphan worktrees. Duplicate starts fresh conversation with same repo/branch configuration.

sources.title: Vibe Kanban docs/workspaces/sessions.mdx
sources.locator: Session independence; Context limits; History
sources.finding: Local sessions are separate processes with separate conversation histories but share workspace files/Git. Switching does not interrupt running agents. New sessions inherit no earlier conversation. Context gauge and complete per-session history are documented; no crash/restart fixture.

sources.locator: Setup/cleanup scripts
sources.finding: Setup runs once at workspace start before agent, not per message. Cleanup runs when workspace closes and may stop services or remove artifacts. Dev server must print URL for preview detection. These are user-supplied scripts, not observed automated repair.

sources.title: Vibe Kanban docs/workspaces/chat-interface.mdx
sources.locator: Plans; Message edits; Tool outputs; Review comments
sources.finding: Plan cards expand specific files/changes and accept approve/request changes. Editing/retry replaces subsequent messages on the conversation branch. Queued follow-ups wait for agent. Tool panels expose command and search results; no complete operational reliability fixture.

sources.title: Vibe Kanban docs/workspaces/changes.mdx
sources.locator: Diff options; GitHub comments; Feedback
sources.finding: Local diffs support unified/side-by-side, filename search, wrap/whitespace and inline feedback. Submitted GitHub review comments can appear inline; pending unsubmitted reviews do not. Feedback reaches agent in later messages.
